The Cryptostars constructor calls the internal mint helper many times to pre-mint reserved tokens.
mint delegates minting to _mint.
buyCryptoStars calls _mint to create each purchased token.
buyCryptoStars calls starsAvailable to verify remaining supply.
buyCryptoStars calls _exists to skip already minted token ids.
giftCryptoStars calls _mint to create each gifted token.
giftCryptoStars calls _exists to skip already minted token ids.
starsAvailable reads super.totalSupply(), dispatching to the overridden totalSupply.
tokenURI uses _exists for its existence requirement.
_safeMint performs the state-changing mint through _mint before the receiver check.
The onlyOwner modifier guards giftCryptoStars before its body runs.
onlyOwner calls owner() to compare against the caller.
onlyOwner calls _msgSender() to obtain the caller identity.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
_safeMint performs an external callback to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received via _checkOnERC721Received, allowing recipient reentrancy.
